info.title: Mundo-3D API
info.description: REST API for the Mundo-3D storefront and admin backend.

error.description: Human-readable message (Spanish), safe to show to end users.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code for programmatic handling.

hasPriceDrift.description: True when unitPrice no longer matches the live product price.

cookieAuth.name: m3d_auth
cookieAuth.description: JWT issued on login/register, required by apiAuthMiddleware.

csrfHeader.name: x-csrf-token
csrfHeader.description: Required by csrfGuard on unsafe methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) for authenticated routes.

post.description: Sets m3d_auth (JWT, httpOnly), m3d_csrf and a display-data cookie. Also accepts `Email`/`Password` (normalized to lowercase before validation).

401.description: Email or password do not match.

post.summary: Register a new user and receive session cookies

password.description: Needs an uppercase, a digit and a special char.

post.summary: Clear session cookies and revoke the refresh token family
post.description: No apiAuthMiddleware — logout only ever removes authority, so it must succeed even with no/expired auth cookie (api-jwt-auth spec, "Logout without an active session"). Revokes the refresh family carried in the (verified) access JWT's familyId claim, when present.

post.summary: Exchange a valid refresh cookie for a fresh access token
post.description: Authenticates solely via the httpOnly, path-scoped m3d_refresh cookie — does NOT require a valid/unexpired m3d_auth. Not behind apiAuthMiddleware, exempt from csrfGuard, rate-limited (refreshLimiter). Rotates the presented token on every current use; a token superseded less than 30s ago (grace window) returns a fresh access cookie only and sets no refresh cookie (refresh-token-rotation spec).

200.description: Refreshed. Sets a new m3d_auth cookie, and a new m3d_refresh cookie only on rotation (never on a grace hit).

get.summary: Get one user by id (admin only)

get.description: Public, paginated product search-and-filter (product-catalog-search spec). Combines `search`, `idCategory`, `idFranchise` with AND semantics; `search` matches case-insensitively as a substring against `name_product` OR `description_product`. No matches, an empty search term, or a well-formed filter matching nothing is a 200 with an empty page, never a 404. Independent of `GET /products` and its pagination constants.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on name or description.

get.summary: List all products, with a per-category count breakdown
Get the most recently created product

put.summary: Update a product (ADMIN/STAFF) — never modifies stock
put.description: All body fields optional (partial update). `stock` is intentionally ignored even if sent — stock mutation happens exclusively via PATCH /products/{id}/stock.

patch.summary: Adjust a product's stock by a signed delta (ADMIN/STAFF)

400.description: delta is not a non-zero integer.

409.description: Insufficient stock for the requested decrease.

post.summary: Check out the caller's cart into an order

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated dedup token (order-checkout spec). Missing/blank -> 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

409.description: Empty cart, or insufficient stock for one or more items.

get.summary: List the caller's own orders, paginated
get.description: Buyer-scoped order history (order-history spec). Registered before `/orders/{id}` — "mine" must never be captured by that route's `:id` param.

200.description: Paginated summary list of the caller's own orders.

get.description: No adminGuard: the controller compares the requester against the order's owner and returns 404 for a non-owner (avoids order-id enumeration), with an ADMIN bypass — design.md "Routes and the ADMIN guard".

404.description: Not found, or not owned by the caller (non-ADMIN).

post.summary: Confirm payment for an order (admin only)
Cancel an order and restock its items (admin only)

items.description: May be empty (represents an emptied cart).
